justification.text: `c / log (log N)` is the problem's exponent c/log log N in N^{c/log log N}, because the statement is `∀ᶠ N in atTop`, and for every N ≥ 3 we have log N > 1 so log log N > 0; the finitely many N where the denominator is zero or negative are outside the eventual range and cannot change the claim.

This sits in N^(c / log log N) under ∀ᶠ N in atTop, so only large N matter. For N ≥ 3, log N > 1 and log log N > 0, so the junk value at N ≤ 2 cannot change the claimed upper bound f_r(N) ≤ N^(c/log log N).
`r ≥ 3` is the problem's own range: the docstring says 'Let r ≥ 3' and states the conjectural upper bound 'for all r ≥ 3'.
